prefill: Require median paired candidate/baseline latency <= 1.03. Report every pair and dispersion; no favorable retries.
memory: Require lower median peak RSS and lower RSS in at least four of five pairs. Report all ratios and absolute GiB.
decode: Require median paired steady decode throughput >= 0.97; report first-step latency and every pair.
failures: Stop on failure; preserve all attempts; no retries to obtain favorable results.
profile: Separate diagnostic run after timed block. Raw invalid-counter values must be preserved, not accepted as valid timing.
claim_scope: 32K/128 Rust-to-Rust development improvement; no updated Rust-versus-DwarfStar throughput claim.
